note: Both sets are accurate on the values they state, with quotes that support the claims and correct units and bindings. Set B adds the drivetrain structural-damping ratio of 5% critical with its free-free-mode conditions, an important fact Set A omits. However, B's three extra claims include two restatements of facts already captured (the driveshaft spring constant and generator inertia, given under slightly different names), so its advantage is one net new correct claim plus some duplication. Set A is otherwise clean but misses the damping ratio.
remarks: Both sets heavily duplicate table and body-text statements of the same fact (efficiency, rated speeds, gearbox ratio, brake torque, damping constant), which inflates claim counts without adding information. Facts both sets miss include the DOWEC-derived 0.35 MW loss at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power, the 5,025,500 kg•m2 DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft inertia, and the linear-ramp brake engagement profile over 0.6 s.
